claims.feature: Side-by-side text and code comparison with word or character highlights
tests: ui:text-diff-checker:one changed line is highlighted with stats and a hunk bar
ui:text-diff-checker:character granularity isolates a one-letter change

claims.feature: Merge changes block by block into an editable result
tests: ui:text-diff-checker:merge: per-hunk decisions and accept/keep all
ui:text-diff-checker:bug 11: accept all / keep all give exactly the modified / original text with ignore options on
ui:text-diff-checker:three-way merge: auto-merge, conflict markers, click resolution

claims.feature: Ignore whitespace, case, trailing spaces and blank lines
tests: ui:text-diff-checker:normalisation options: whitespace, case, trailing, blank, CRLF
ui:text-diff-checker:bug 15: ignore blank lines reports no change for an added blank line

claims.feature: Large files without freezing (background worker, cancel, virtual rendering)
tests: ui:text-diff-checker:bug 9: unrelated 20,000-line files run in a worker, end in a summary, and a long run can be cancelled
ui:text-diff-checker:bug 20: a 100,000-line comparison renders only the rows on screen

claims.feature: Encodings and line endings reported (Windows-1252, UTF-16, CRLF, final newline)
tests: ui:text-diff-checker:bug 2: Windows-1252 files are decoded, labelled, and never reported identical when bytes differ
ui:text-diff-checker:bug 14: line endings and a missing final newline are reported; merged output keeps CRLF

claims.feature: Folder compare by content, size or date, with ignore filters and a tree
tests: ui:text-diff-checker:feature 21: real folders: tree with counts, default ignores, filters, open a file and come back
ui:text-diff-checker:feature 21: compare by size and by date, CSV report, folder drag and drop
ui:text-diff-checker:feature 21: 20,000 files hash in a worker with progress and Cancel, never guessing

claims.feature: Every sheet of two Excel workbooks
tests: ui:text-diff-checker:feature 22: every sheet is compared, with tabs, a summary and renamed sheets

claims.feature: Table compare by key columns with tolerance, date and number rules
tests: ui:text-diff-checker:feature 23: composite keys, ignored columns, tolerance, dates, filter, sort and column summary
unit:diff:feature 23: composite keys, ignored columns and the per-column summary
unit:diff:feature 23: trim, ignore case and empty = null
unit:diff:feature 23: numbers: 1.0 = 1, absolute and percentage tolerance, long numbers stay exact
unit:diff:feature 23: dates in different formats compare equal when asked

claims.feature: Hex / binary compare of large files
tests: ui:text-diff-checker:feature 24: hex compare shows offsets, both sides, highlighted bytes, next/previous difference and jump to offset
ui:text-diff-checker:feature 24: two 160 MB files are read in slices, scanned with progress, and stay scrollable
ui:text-diff-checker:feature 24: empty, identical, single-sided and folder-opened binaries
unit:diff:feature 24: byteRanges finds differing runs, merges across chunk boundaries and counts the tail
unit:diff:feature 24: parseOffset reads hex and decimal offsets and rejects junk
unit:diff:feature 24: hexOffset pads to the width the file needs

claims.feature: Image compare with pixel difference and tolerance
tests: ui:text-diff-checker:feature 25: image compare: side by side, slider, onion skin, difference, % changed and the details of both files
ui:text-diff-checker:feature 25: the pixel tolerance ignores small colour shifts such as re-compression
ui:text-diff-checker:feature 25: JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP and SVG; mismatched dimensions, misnamed files and non-images
unit:diff:feature 25: imageFormat sniffs PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP and SVG by their bytes, not the name
unit:diff:feature 25: pixelDiff counts changed pixels with a tolerance and draws a difference image
unit:diff:feature 25: pixelDiff with different dimensions compares the union and counts the uncovered area

claims.feature: Reports: patch, HTML, CSV, Excel with highlighted cells, JSON
tests: ui:text-diff-checker:feature 26: table exports: CSV with original/modified columns and .xlsx with highlighted cells, both stating options and date
ui:text-diff-checker:feature 26: a workbook comparison exports every sheet to one .xlsx
ui:text-diff-checker:feature 26: JSON/YAML path changes export as CSV and JSON; text and folder reports keep options and date
ui:text-diff-checker:feature 26: hex exports the differing byte ranges (CSV and HTML); images export an HTML report and the difference image
unit:diff:feature 26: tableCsv has the options and date, then old/new column pairs for every row
unit:diff:feature 26: tableCsv quotes commas, quotes, newlines and keeps leading zeros and formula-like text
unit:diff:feature 26: structure changes export as CSV and as JSON with exact long numbers
unit:diff:feature 26: hexRangesCsv lists each differing range with offsets and the bytes on both sides
unit:diff:feature 26: xlsxBuild writes a valid workbook with highlighted cells, exact text and safe sheet names

claims.feature: Unified patches: export and apply, multi-file, fuzz with confirmation
tests: ui:text-diff-checker:patch export is a unified diff that re-applies cleanly
ui:text-diff-checker:bug 12: a multi-file patch lists every file and applies each one
ui:text-diff-checker:bug 12: a fuzzy patch shows the mismatched context lines and needs confirmation
